identity.title: Actual selective upstream Oracle3 arbitrage and fee component reuse in native REL research
identity.objective: Genuinely reuse the pinned upstream Oracle3 pure-math and fee modules in an isolated native related-market evidence consumer, while preserving S10-R3-REL-01 exact-fee/depth governance and all 36 capability statuses. Do not install the trading framework or create a second economics/fee engine. Benchmark upsteam decisions as conditional corroboration; do not claim real settlement, fees, executable edge or operational Alpha. This owner-authorized one-shot CI closure also restores one pre-existing date-expired SDK-probe pytest assertion and sanitizes wording in the WP spec without weakening the full-history security scanner.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert only these 14 paths; the prior verified S10-R3-REL-01, SRC-01, official SDK probe, source hashes and receipts remain byte-identical. The five exact upstream files and license files are passive and called only by the opt-in independent offline research CLI. The extra existing SDK-probe pytest compatibility edit restores a stable acquisition-time conflict assertion only; production SDK probe code, owner activation and history remain unchanged.
